ActivateFlowLog.description_en: Enables log delivery for a flow log

AttachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance.description_en: Attaches a child instance (VBR) to an Express Connect Router (ECR)

CheckAddRegionToExpressConnectRouter.description_en: Checks the Cloud Data Transfer (CDT) service, which is required to add a region to an Express Connect Router (ECR)
CheckAddRegionToExpressConnectRouter.description_zh: 检查指定的地域加入专线网关所需的云数据传输服务

CreateExpressConnectRouter.description_zh: 新建专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）

CreateExpressConnectRouterAssociation.description_en: Associates a virtual private cloud (VPC) or transit router (TR) with an Express Connect Router (ECR)
CreateExpressConnectRouterAssociation.description_zh: 专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）关联专有网络（VPC）或者转发路由器（TR）

CreateFlowLog.description_en: Creates a flow log. Log delivery is enabled by default when a flow log is created
CreateFlowLog.description_zh: 创建流日志默认开启日志投递

DeactivateFlowLog.description_en: Deactivates log delivery for a flow log

DeleteExpressConnectRouter.description_zh: 删除专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）

DeleteExpressConnectRouterAssociation.description_en: Dissociates an Express Connect Router (ECR) from a virtual private cloud (VPC) or a transit router
DeleteExpressConnectRouterAssociation.description_zh: 解除专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）与专有网络（VPC）或者转发路由器的关联关系

DescribeDisabledExpressConnectRouterRout.description_en: Queries the disabled route entries for an Express Connect Router (ECR)
DescribeDisabledExpressConnectRouterRout.description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）禁用的路由条目

DescribeExpressConnectRouter.description_en: Queries a list of Express Connect Router (ECR) instances
DescribeExpressConnectRouter.description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）列表

DescribeExpressConnectRouterAllowedPrefi.description_en: Queries the prefix route history for an Express Connect Router (ECR)
DescribeExpressConnectRouterAllowedPrefi.description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）前缀路由的历史记录

DescribeExpressConnectRouterAssociation.description_en: Queries the virtual private clouds (VPCs) and transit routers (TRs) associated with an Express Connect Router (ECR)
DescribeExpressConnectRouterAssociation.description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）关联的专有网络（VPC）和转发路由器（TR）

DescribeExpressConnectRouterChildInstanc.description_en: Queries the virtual border routers (VBRs) loaded on an Express Connect Router (ECR)
DescribeExpressConnectRouterChildInstanc.description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）加载的边界路由器（VBR）

DescribeExpressConnectRouterInterRegionT.description_en: Queries the inter-region transit mode of an Express Connect Router (ECR)
DescribeExpressConnectRouterInterRegionT.description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）的跨地域转发模式

DescribeExpressConnectRouterRegion.description_en: Queries the regions that contain Express Connect Router (ECR) resources
DescribeExpressConnectRouterRegion.description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）相关资源的所在地域列表

DescribeExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries.description_en: Describes the route entries of an Express Connect Router (ECR)
DescribeExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries.description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）路由条目

DescribeInstanceGrantedToExpressConnectR.description_en: Queries the network instances that are granted to an Express Connect Router (ECR)
DescribeInstanceGrantedToExpressConnectR.description_zh: 查询授权给专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）的网络实例

DetachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance.description_en: Detaches a virtual border router (VBR) from an Express Connect Router (ECR)
DetachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance.description_zh: 从专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）卸载边界路由器（VBR）

DisableExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries.description_en: Disables route entries for an Express Connect Router (ECR)
DisableExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries.description_zh: 禁用专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）路由项

EnableExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries.description_en: Enables route entries for an Express Connect Router (ECR)
EnableExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries.description_zh: 启用专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）路由条目

ForceDeleteExpressConnectRouter.description_en: Force deletes an Express Connect Router (ECR) and detaches its associated virtual private clouds (VPCs), Transit Routers (TRs), and virtual border routers (VBRs)
ForceDeleteExpressConnectRouter.description_zh: 删除专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router），并解绑相关联的专有网络（VPC），转发路由器（TR）和边界路由器（VBR）

GrantInstanceToExpressConnectRouter.description_en: Grants a virtual private cloud (VPC) or virtual border router (VBR) authorization to a cross-account Express Connect Router (ECR)
GrantInstanceToExpressConnectRouter.description_zh: 将的专有网络（VPC）或者边界路由器（VBR）授权给跨账号的专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）

ListExpressConnectRouterSupportedRegion.description_en: Queries the regions that support Express Connect Router (ECR)
ListExpressConnectRouterSupportedRegion.description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）开服地域列表

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the list of tags bound to an Express Connect Router (ECR)
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询专线网关绑定的标签列表

ModifyExpressConnectRouter.description_en: Modifies the properties of an Express Connect Router (ECR), such as its name
ModifyExpressConnectRouter.description_zh: 修改专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）的名称等属性

ModifyExpressConnectRouterAssociation.description_en: Modifies the parameters of an instance associated with an Express Connect Router (ECR)
ModifyExpressConnectRouterAssociation.description_zh: 修改专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）关联的子实例属性

ModifyExpressConnectRouterAssociationAll.description_en: Modifies the prefixes for a virtual private cloud (VPC) or a transit router that is attached to an Express Connect Router (ECR)
ModifyExpressConnectRouterAssociationAll.description_zh: 修改专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）绑定的专有网络（VPC）或者转发路由器（TR）的前缀路由

ModifyExpressConnectRouterChildInstance.description_en: Modifies the properties of a virtual border router (VBR) associated with an Express Connect Router (ECR)
ModifyExpressConnectRouterChildInstance.description_zh: 修改专线网关（ExpressConnectRouter）关联子实例(VBR)的属性

ModifyExpressConnectRouterInterRegionTra.description_en: Modifies the inter-region forwarding mode of an Express Connect Router (ECR)
ModifyExpressConnectRouterInterRegionTra.description_zh: 修改专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）的跨地域转发模式

ModifyFlowLogAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name, description, sample rate, and sampling period of a flow log
ModifyFlowLogAttribute.description_zh: 可以修改名称、描述、采样率、采样周期

MoveResourceGroup.description_en: Modifies the resource group to which an Express Connect Router (ECR) belongs
MoveResourceGroup.description_zh: 修改专线网关所属的资源组

RevokeInstanceFromExpressConnectRouter.description_en: Revokes the authorization of a virtual private cloud (VPC) or virtual border router (VBR) on a cross-account Express Connect Router (ECR)
RevokeInstanceFromExpressConnectRouter.description_zh: 撤销专有网络（VPC）或者边界路由器（VBR）对跨账号的专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）的授权

SynchronizeExpressConnectRouterInterRegi.description_en: Synchronizes the inter-region bandwidth limits for an Express Connect Router (ECR)
SynchronizeExpressConnectRouterInterRegi.description_zh: 同步专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）的各地域之间的转发带宽限制

TagResources.description_en: Binds tags to an Express Connect Router (ECR). Each call to this operation binds tags to a single ECR instance, but you can bind multiple tags at a time
TagResources.description_zh: 专线网关绑定标签。每次调用该 API 只能为一个专线网关绑定标签，可一次绑定多个标签

UntagResources.description_en: Unbinds tags from an Express Connect Router (ECR)
